newsitem.title: GERMANY: Horlick-had fair hearing from Deutsche Bank lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Horlick-had fair hearing from Deutsche Bank lawyer.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, former head of British pension fund business at MGAM, said on Friday that she had a "a fair hearing" in a two-hour meeting with members of Deutsche Bank's legal and personnel departments.

"I feel I have had a fair hearing. We had a reasonable conversation. The (Deutsche Bank) lawyers will now examine the facts that are on the other side. I am happy with that and I am going home to see my children," Horlick told Reuters en route to the airport.
The two-hour meeting was attended by a representative of Deutsche Bank's legal department, a member of the personnel department and a Reuters reporter acting as witness to the talks.
A statement was agreed in the presence of the Deutsche Bank lawyer. Details of the statement cannot be reported.

Horlick was suspended earlier from Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Asset Management this week pending the outcome of an investigation into what DMG described as "a potential breach of her contract" and Horlick resigned on Thursday.
